ASR/diarization errors propagate into topic windows.
Topic labels are model candidates and require human review.
Topic boundaries and hierarchy are not validated against annotations.

report_metadata.method: Single BERTopic model over transcript windows; broad topics via agglomerative merge of base topics.
report_metadata.semantic_policy: All topic labels are candidate vocabulary entries, not observed facts.
